metadata.title: Expanders prevent Property (H)
metadata.abstract: We show that if a sequence of expander graphs equi-coarsely embeds into a Banach space, then this Banach space fails Kasparov and Yu's Property (H). Consequently, no Banach space with Property (H) can be coarsely universal for all countable groups. We provide a Lean verification of our results.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 证明若一列扩张图等一致粗嵌入某 Banach 空间，则该空间不满足 Kasparov–Yu 的 Property (H)。
analysis.breakthrough: 排除具有 Property (H) 的 Banach 空间对所有可数群的粗普适性。
analysis.limitations: 结论针对等一致粗嵌入；Lean 验证本身不构成 AI 使用证据。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
